attacks.name: injected_price_inflation
attacks.story: Hidden text on a product page tells the agent to charge Rs 20,000. It edits the merchant's cart and resubmits.
attacks.reason: no valid signature from merchant merchant:freshcart

attacks.name: forged_mandate
attacks.story: Agent mints its own mandate with an unlimited budget, signed with a key it controls, claiming to be the user.
attacks.reason: no valid signature from user user:priya

attacks.name: forged_cart
attacks.story: Attacker signs a cart while claiming to be the real merchant.
attacks.reason: no valid signature from merchant merchant:freshcart

attacks.name: stolen_mandate
attacks.story: A second agent replays a mandate scoped to another agent. Both documents are genuine -- the presenter is not the one authorised.
attacks.reason: mandate authorises agent agent:claude, which did not sign this cart

attacks.name: float_paise
attacks.story: A cart priced in floating point. 1000 == 1000.0 passes a loose arithmetic check and puts a float on a money path.
attacks.reason: every amount and quantity must be an integer number of paise

attacks.name: counterfeit_storefront
attacks.story: A fake shop with below-market prices, exactly the Visa threat model. It signs its own cart correctly -- but it is not the merchant the user authorised.
attacks.reason: mandate is scoped to merchant:freshcart, cart is from merchant:evilmart

attacks.name: dishonest_cart_arithmetic
attacks.story: A compromised merchant signs a cart whose line items do not add up to the total being charged.

attacks.name: expensive_sku_redirect
attacks.story: Injection routes the agent to a real but wildly overpriced SKU at the legitimate merchant, so every signature is valid.

attacks.name: budget_drain
attacks.story: Agent spends the mandate down to Rs 4,500 of Rs 5,000, then tries one more purchase that would take it over.

attacks.name: replay
attacks.story: Agent resubmits a cart that already settled, to be charged twice.

attacks.name: expired_mandate
attacks.story: Agent holds a mandate past its expiry and uses it later.

attacks.name: stale_quote
attacks.story: Agent pays an old quote after the price has moved.

attacks.name: self_countersign
attacks.story: Agent tries to sign the human approval itself for a purchase above the user's threshold.
attacks.reason: 140000 is above the 100000 auto-approval threshold and carries no user signature

attacks.name: cross_mandate_cart
attacks.story: Agent pairs a cart issued against a different mandate with this one.
attacks.reason: cart cites intent SOMEONE_ELSE, presented mandate is INT1

attacks.name: revoked_mandate
attacks.story: User revokes mid-session; the agent keeps going.

attacks.name: over_per_txn_cap
attacks.story: A single purchase larger than the user's per-transaction ceiling.

benign.name: mid_size_basket
benign.story: A basket just under the approval threshold.

benign.name: multi_item_cart
benign.story: Several line items that sum correctly.

benign.name: exactly_at_threshold
benign.story: Priced exactly at the approval threshold.

benign.name: exactly_at_per_txn_cap
benign.story: Priced exactly at the per-transaction cap, with the user's approval attached.

benign.name: human_approved_large
benign.story: Above the threshold, and the human really did approve it.
